Initial release of Financial AI Strategy Architect.

- Provides key strategic models for AI transformation in financial institutions (banking, insurance, securities, funds).

- Supplies ready-to-use Python templates for ROI calculation and AI maturity assessment.
- Offers concise compliance checklists for Chinese regulations (CBIRC, PIPL).
- Based on industry practice and up-to-date compliance guidance.
